scene_prompt: Create a realistic Roblox-adapted stadium-scale concert venue for a world tour, with a massive main stage at one end facing a broad audience floor and tiered stadium seating. Build the stage as an elaborate large-scale pop concert production with a wide central performance platform, prominent lighting and screen structures, and a long runway extending into the crowd.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Entertainment (Showcase & Hub): this is an attended concert experience rather than a performance game or competitive event.

### Shape and preset
Use `venue-stage`, matching the Performance Venue preset. The stage is the focal end of a stadium-scale audience space, with all audience sightlines converging toward it; retain the preset’s audience-oriented form without adding performer-side gameplay areas.

### Config requirements
Use visible `spectator-bleachers` for broad, raked stadium seating framing the audience floor and keeping rear audience views clear. Use visible `social-hub` for the large standing audience floor between seating and stage, sized for dense player congregation. Use visible `spawn-first-reveal` by placing arrival at the rear or side of the audience zone with the illuminated main stage immediately legible ahead. No invisible gameplay volumes are required.

### Layout components
The venue is a single stadium bowl. Place a massive main stage at one short end, spanning much of the venue width. Its central performance platform is broad and raised, backed and flanked by prominent large screen walls, lighting towers, truss structures, and concert-production rigging. A long central runway projects straight from the stage into the audience floor, ending well before the far seating edge and leaving circulation space on both sides.

The broad standing audience floor fills the center of the stadium, with the runway dividing its forward portion into balanced left and right crowd areas. Tiered stadium seating wraps the rear and both long sides of this floor, rising in continuous banks toward the outer perimeter. Keep the boundary as the enclosing stadium bowl and seating structure; no separate backstage or interior zones are needed. Compose the scene symmetrically along the stage-to-runway axis, with the enormous screen-and-light silhouette dominating one end and the audience mass opening toward it.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the authoritative first render is an isometric concert-production view, because the stage spectacle, seating scale, and visual sightlines lead the design rather than requiring procedurally validated topology.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by the stadium-scale world-tour presentation, expansive audience floor, long runway, and full surrounding seating bowl. Theme: realistic large-scale pop concert production adapted to Roblox, with monumental staging, screens, and theatrical lighting infrastructure. Use `P0`; the tiered seating is non-overhanging relief and does not require an additional capture path.
